Wembanyama was the NBA Rookie of the Year in 2024, and he's averaging 25.7 points, 10.7 rebounds, 4.0 blocks, 3.3 assists and 1.3 steals per game early in the season. Meanwhile, Flagg was the 2026 NBA Rookie of the Year, and the teenager is averaging 25.2 points, 6.5 assists, 5.7 rebounds, 2.5 steals and 1.0 blocks in his second season.
